ruling: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-18 — G1's AGGREGATE SEQUENCING INTERPRETATION IS SUPERSEDED. Individual proof obligations are not.

historicalG1.whyItsAggregateReadingBecameImpossible: G1 was written to terminate Stage-5's W1, which contained CH-04 PHASE 1 and the CH-11 chapter head. The first executable wave was later RE-DERIVED from canonical evidence and CH-04 PHASE 1 was REFUSED (AD-CON-5 outstanding, SU-5 unsettled, VS-02 environmental, real devices unavailable), while CH-11 was admitted only conditionally and then bounded to its ungated portion. The executed wave is therefore NARROWER than the gate that terminates it. Read as an aggregate, G1 could never open — not because any proof failed, but because it retained prerequisites belonging to branches the evidence correctly excluded.
historicalG1.whatIsNotSuperseded: No individual G1 proof obligation is deleted, weakened, waived or discharged. Nothing is marked PASS that was not proven.

forwardRule.statement: PROOF GATES FOLLOW DEPENDENCIES; THEY DO NOT GLOBALLY FREEZE UNRELATED WORK MERELY BECAUSE THEY ONCE SHARED A WAVE.
forwardRule.corollary: A wave is an execution-planning construct. It cannot manufacture a technical dependency, and historical wave membership is not itself a prerequisite.
forwardRule.failClosedPreserved: Every genuinely unproven dependency remains fail-closed and attaches to the specific capability it actually proves.

5A_enumeration.question: Can 'every ingestion door ENUMERATED' be established deterministically from repository/runtime architecture without production mutation?
5A_enumeration.answer: ESTABLISHED — enumeration complete AND every enumerated door now passes through a governed validation boundary, following the D7-DEFECT closure.
5A_enumeration.definition: An ingestion door is any code path by which caller-supplied bytes, or a caller-supplied reference to stored bytes, becomes a persisted Media row or a stored object. Reading, projecting and deleting are not ingestion.

doors.finding: institution-posts.service.ts:728 creates Media at status=READY from a caller-supplied URL, mimeType left null, type defaulted to IMAGE. No ownership proof, no headObject, no MIME or size check — structurally the shape F129 had before it was closed.

5A_enumeration.closureIsBidirectional: The suite re-derives the door set from source and fails if a media.create appears off-register, AND fails if a registered door does not actually ingest. The second check exists because an earlier draft listed a seventh door, 'D6-POST-MEDIA', on the strength of a grep that matched `media.createdAt`. posts.service.ts ATTACHES existing media by id and creates nothing; it is now recorded as an explained NON-door. The register is trustworthy only because it is re-derived rather than trusted.
5A_enumeration.notClaimed: 5(A) does not discharge leg 5. Enumeration proved coverage is incomplete; it did not create coverage.
5A_enumeration.correction: An earlier line in this artifact recorded 5(A) as simply ESTABLISHED. That overstated it. G1 leg 5 requires doors 'ENUMERATED and proven to pass through the same validation'. Enumeration is complete at 6 doors; common validation is not, because D7 bypasses it. See d7-discovered-defect-candidate.json.
5A_enumeration.d7Closure: D7 was the single uncovered door. Admitted as an execution defect and closed under the founder ruling of 2026-08-18; the door register now records CLIENT_KEY_DOOR coverage for it.

5B_liveRefusal.requirement: A deliberately violating file REFUSED LIVE with a truthful, visible, RECOVERABLE refusal, observed against an attributable deployed artifact.
5B_liveRefusal.localEvidenceThatDoesNotSubstitute: media.service.client-supplied-key.spec.ts demonstrates six real rejections with machine-readable codes and recoverable messages. Per the founder ruling this does NOT satisfy the live obligation.
5B_liveRefusal.additionalBlocker: The F129 door is not deployed — it is in the 8 unpushed local commits. A live refusal cannot be observed against an artifact that does not contain the door.
